svg.title: Checkout, from cart to parcel
svg.desc: Flow chart with 8 steps and 8 connections. Main path: Cart ready → Take payment → Payment provider → Paid? → Reserve stock → Ship parcel → Delivered. Most connected: Paid? and Reserve stock (3 connections each). Nothing leads out of Orders. Loop: Cart ready → Take payment → Payment provider → Paid? → Cart ready. Bottlenecks: Paid? and Reserve stock; without either the diagram falls apart. Cart ready (start): leads to Take payment. Take payment: leads to Payment provider (authorise). Payment provider (external): leads to Paid?. Paid? (decision): leads to Reserve stock (yes) and Cart ready (no, try another card). Reserve stock: leads to Orders (reserve) and Ship parcel. Orders (data store): no further step. Ship parcel: leads to Delivered. Delivered (end): no further step.

polyline.title: Paid? → Cart ready: no, try another card
